name: Appmax
description: Brazilian online payment gateway for e-commerce focused on credit card conversion: optimized checkout, Pix, subscriptions, split payments and native Shopify integration.
notes: Preferred for card payments. Advertised rates (Nov 2026): 3.49% credit card, 0.99% Pix, decreasing with volume; payout in up to one day. Supports Apple Pay / Google Pay.
